title: Paneer Butter Masala
blurb: Silky tomato gravy with soft paneer cubes – restaurant style at home.
steps: Boil tomatoes and onions for 8 minutes, cool and blend to a smooth puree.
Melt the butter, add the puree with chilli powder and simmer for 10 minutes.
Stir in garam masala, crushed kasuri methi and the cream.
Add paneer cubes and cook for 3 minutes. Garnish with coriander.

title: Veg Biryani
blurb: Fragrant layered rice with vegetables, mint and whole spices.
steps: Soak the rice for 20 minutes and parboil with cardamom until 70% cooked.
Fry sliced onions until golden. Cook carrots and peas with curd and biryani masala.
Layer vegetables and rice, top with fried onions, mint and coriander.
Cover tightly and steam on low heat for 20 minutes.

title: Dal Tadka
blurb: Everyday yellow dal finished with a sizzling cumin and chilli tadka.
steps: Pressure cook the washed dal with turmeric and 3 cups of water for 4 whistles.
Heat butter, crackle the cumin seeds, then fry onion, green chilli and tomato.
Add chilli powder, pour in the mashed dal and simmer for 5 minutes.
Finish with coriander and serve hot with rice.

title: Chole Masala
blurb: Slow-simmered chickpea curry with a deep, spicy gravy.
steps: Soak chickpeas overnight and pressure cook until soft.
Fry onions until brown, add tomato and the spice powders and cook to a thick masala.
Add chickpeas and a cup of water, simmer for 15 minutes.
Finish with garam masala and fresh coriander.

title: Kanda Poha
blurb: Light, fluffy flattened rice with peanuts, curry leaves and lemon.
steps: Rinse poha gently and rest for 5 minutes.
Crackle mustard seeds, fry peanuts, then cook potato, onion and green chilli.
Add turmeric and the poha, toss gently for 3 minutes.
Top with coriander and serve with a squeeze of lemon.

title: Masala Chai
blurb: Strong, spiced milk tea – the proper way.
steps: Boil a cup of water with cardamom and cinnamon for 2 minutes.
Add tea leaves and sugar and simmer for 1 minute.
Pour in the milk, bring to a boil twice, strain and serve.

title: Pasta Arrabbiata
blurb: Spicy tomato pasta with oregano and melted cheese.
steps: Boil the penne in salted water until al dente.
Sauté onion, add pasta sauce, chilli flakes and oregano and simmer for 8 minutes.
Toss the pasta through, top with mozzarella and rest for a minute.

title: Grilled Veg Sandwich
blurb: Crunchy vegetables, chaat masala and melted cheese between toasted bread.
steps: Butter the bread and layer cucumber, tomato and onion slices with chaat masala.
Add a cheese slice and close the sandwich.
Grill or toast for 3–4 minutes each side until golden.

title: Pomfret Fish Curry
blurb: Tangy, spicy coastal-style curry with fresh pomfret.
steps: Marinate the fish with turmeric and salt for 15 minutes.
Cook onions, tomatoes and the spice powders to a thick masala.
Add 1.5 cups of water, bring to a simmer and slide in the fish.
Cook covered for 8–10 minutes and finish with coriander.

title: Fluffy Pancake Stack
blurb: Soft pancakes with maple syrup and fresh strawberries.
steps: Whisk maida, baking powder and sugar, then stir in milk and melted butter.
Cook ladlefuls on a buttered pan until bubbles form, then flip.
Stack and serve with maple syrup and sliced strawberries.

title: Chocolate Walnut Brownies
blurb: Fudgy brownies with chocolate chips and crunchy walnuts.
steps: Melt the butter and combine with the brownie mix and vanilla.
Fold in chocolate chips and chopped walnuts.
Bake at 180°C for 25 minutes. Cool before cutting.

title: Banana Oat Smoothie Bowl
blurb: Thick, creamy and topped with oats, berries and chia.
steps: Blend frozen banana with yogurt and honey until thick.
Pour into a bowl and top with oats, sliced strawberries and chia seeds.

title: Ice Cream Cold Coffee
blurb: Frothy chilled coffee with a scoop of ice cream.
steps: Blend milk, coffee mix and sugar with ice until frothy.
Pour into glasses and top with a scoop of ice cream.

title: Fruit Chaat
blurb: Seasonal fruit tossed with chaat masala and black salt.
steps: Chop the apples and bananas and mix with grapes and pomegranate.
Sprinkle chaat masala and black salt, toss and serve chilled.

title: Palak Paneer
blurb: Paneer cubes in a silky spinach gravy.
steps: Blanch the spinach for 2 minutes, then blend to a smooth puree.
Fry onion, ginger, garlic and tomato in butter until soft.
Add the spinach puree and garam masala and simmer for 5 minutes.
Stir in the paneer and cream and cook for 3 minutes.

title: Shahi Paneer
blurb: Rich, mild paneer curry with cashew and cream.
steps: Boil tomatoes, onions and cashews together, cool and blend smooth.
Cook the puree in butter with chilli powder for 8 minutes.
Add garam masala, crushed kasuri methi and cream.
Fold in the paneer and simmer for 3 minutes.

title: Kadai Paneer
blurb: Paneer and capsicum in a thick, spicy tomato masala.
steps: Heat oil, fry the sliced onions and capsicum for 3 minutes and set aside.
Cook chopped tomato with coriander powder and chilli powder to a thick masala.
Add paneer and the fried vegetables and toss on high heat for 3 minutes.
Finish with garam masala and fresh coriander.

title: Rajma Masala
blurb: Kidney beans slow-cooked in a tomato and onion gravy.
steps: Soak rajma overnight and pressure cook until soft.
Fry onion, ginger and garlic, then cook the tomatoes with the spices.
Add the rajma with a cup of its water and simmer for 15 minutes.
Mash a few beans to thicken and serve with rice.

title: Dal Fry
blurb: Everyday toor dal with a garlicky cumin tadka.
steps: Pressure cook the dal with turmeric until completely soft.
Crackle cumin, then fry garlic, onion, green chilli and tomato.
Pour in the dal, add chilli powder and simmer for 5 minutes.
Garnish with coriander.

title: Dal Makhani
blurb: Creamy black dal simmered with butter and cream.
steps: Soak urad dal and rajma overnight, then pressure cook until very soft.
Cook onion, ginger, garlic and tomato puree in butter with the spices.
Add the dal and simmer on low for 25 minutes, mashing a little.
Finish with cream and crushed kasuri methi.

title: Aloo Gobi
blurb: Dry potato and cauliflower sabzi with everyday spices.
steps: Crackle cumin in oil, then fry the onion until golden.
Add tomato and the spice powders and cook until soft.
Add potato and cauliflower with a splash of water, cover and cook for 15 minutes.
Garnish with coriander.

title: Aloo Jeera
blurb: Cumin-tempered potatoes, ready in 20 minutes.
steps: Boil, peel and cube the potatoes.
Crackle cumin in oil, add green chilli and turmeric.
Toss in the potatoes and chilli powder and fry for 5 minutes.
Finish with coriander.

title: Bhindi Masala
blurb: Crisp okra cooked with onion and tomato masala.
steps: Wash, dry and slice the okra; fry in oil until no longer sticky.
Cook onion, tomato and the spices to a masala.
Add the okra back and cook uncovered for 8 minutes.

title: Baingan Bharta
blurb: Smoky roasted aubergine mashed with onion and tomato.
steps: Roast the eggplant over a flame or in the oven until charred, then peel and mash.
Crackle cumin, fry garlic, onion and green chilli, then add tomato and spices.
Add the mashed eggplant and cook for 8 minutes. Garnish with coriander.

title: Mixed Vegetable Curry
blurb: Carrot, peas, beans, potato and cauliflower in a light masala.
steps: Crackle cumin, fry the onion and cook the tomato with the spices.
Add the chopped vegetables and a cup of water.
Cover and cook for 15 minutes until tender. Finish with garam masala.

title: Vegetable Pulao
blurb: Fragrant basmati rice with peas, carrot and beans.
steps: Soak the rice for 20 minutes.
Fry the whole spices and onion in butter, then add the vegetables.
Add the rice and 3 cups of water, cover and cook on low for 15 minutes.

title: Jeera Rice
blurb: Fluffy basmati tempered with cumin and butter.
steps: Rinse and soak the rice for 15 minutes.
Crackle cumin in butter, add the rice and 3 cups of water with salt.
Cover and cook for 12 minutes, rest for 5, then fluff.

title: Masala Khichdi
blurb: Comforting rice and moong dal with vegetables.
steps: Wash the rice and dal together.
Crackle cumin in butter, add chilli, vegetables, turmeric and the rice and dal.
Add 4 cups of water and pressure cook for 3 whistles.
Finish with garam masala.

title: Veg Upma
blurb: Soft semolina cooked with vegetables and mustard seeds.
steps: Dry roast the rava until fragrant and set aside.
Crackle mustard seeds in oil, then fry peanuts, chilli, curry leaves and onion.
Add the vegetables and 2.5 cups of hot water, then stir in the rava.
Cover for 3 minutes and fluff.

title: Pav Bhaji
blurb: Buttery mashed vegetable bhaji with toasted pav.
steps: Boil the potatoes and peas, then mash roughly.
Cook onion, capsicum and tomato in butter with pav bhaji masala.
Add the mash with a cup of water and simmer for 10 minutes.
Toast the pav in butter and serve with coriander and lemon.

title: Masala Dosa
blurb: Crisp fermented rice and dal crepes with a spiced potato filling.
steps: Soak rice and dal for 6 hours, grind to a batter and ferment overnight.
Make the filling: crackle mustard, fry onion and chilli, add boiled mashed potato and turmeric.
Spread batter thin on a hot pan, drizzle oil and cook until crisp.
Fill with the potato masala and fold.

title: Idli
blurb: Soft steamed rice and urad dal cakes.
steps: Soak rice and dal separately for 6 hours and grind to a smooth batter.
Mix, add salt and ferment overnight.
Pour into idli moulds and steam for 12 minutes.

title: Vegetable Uttapam
blurb: Thick dosa-batter pancakes topped with vegetables.
steps: Prepare and ferment the batter as for dosa.
Pour a thick round on a hot pan and scatter the chopped vegetables on top.
Drizzle oil, cook both sides until golden.

title: Samosa
blurb: Crisp pastry parcels filled with spiced potato and peas.
steps: Knead maida with ajwain, salt and oil into a stiff dough and rest for 30 minutes.
Cook boiled mashed potato and peas with the spices for the filling.
Roll, cut and fill into cones, seal with water.
Deep fry on medium heat until golden.

title: Aloo Paratha
blurb: Wheat flatbreads stuffed with spiced potato.
steps: Knead the flour into a soft dough.
Mix mashed potato with onion, coriander, chilli and spices.
Stuff, roll out and cook on a hot pan with butter until golden.

title: Paneer Paratha
blurb: Soft flatbreads with a spiced paneer filling.
steps: Knead the flour into a soft dough.
Crumble the paneer and mix with onion, coriander, chilli and spices.
Stuff, roll out and cook with butter on both sides.

title: Puri Bhaji
blurb: Puffed fried puris with a light potato curry.
steps: Knead a stiff dough, rest 15 minutes, roll into small discs.
Make the bhaji: crackle mustard, cook onion, tomato and turmeric, add boiled chopped potato and water.
Deep fry the puris until puffed and golden.

title: Chole Bhature
blurb: Spicy chickpea curry with fluffy fried bhature.
steps: Soak and pressure cook the chickpeas.
Knead maida with curd, baking soda and salt; rest for 2 hours.
Cook onion, tomato and spices, add the chickpeas and simmer.
Roll the bhature and deep fry until puffed.

title: Mixed Veg Pakora
blurb: Crunchy besan fritters, perfect with chai.
steps: Mix besan with the spices and a little water into a thick batter.
Fold in the sliced vegetables.
Drop spoonfuls into hot oil and fry until golden and crisp.
Sprinkle with chaat masala.

title: Grilled Cheese Sandwich
blurb: Golden toasted bread with melted cheese.
steps: Butter the bread on one side.
Layer cheese and tomato slices between two slices.
Toast on a pan or grill until golden and melted.

title: Veg Burger
blurb: Crispy veg patty in a soft bun with cheese and sauces.
steps: Cook the patties until crisp.
Toast the buns and spread with mayonnaise.
Layer patty, cheese, tomato, onion, lettuce and ketchup.

title: White Sauce Pasta
blurb: Creamy pasta tossed with vegetables and cheese.
steps: Boil the penne until al dente.
Melt butter, stir in maida, then whisk in the milk until thick.
Add cheese, pepper and oregano, then the vegetables and pasta.
Simmer for 2 minutes and serve.

title: Masala Pasta
blurb: Desi-style pasta with onion, tomato and capsicum.
steps: Boil the pasta and drain.
Cook onion, capsicum and tomato in butter with the spices and ketchup.
Toss the pasta through the masala.

title: Veg Hakka Noodles
blurb: Stir-fried noodles with crunchy vegetables.
steps: Boil the noodles, drain and toss with a little oil.
Stir-fry the vegetables on high heat for 3 minutes.
Add the sauces and noodles and toss for 2 minutes.

title: Veg Fried Rice
blurb: Wok-tossed rice with vegetables and soy.
steps: Cook the rice, spread out and cool completely.
Stir-fry the chopped vegetables on high heat.
Add the rice, soy sauce, chilli sauce and pepper and toss for 3 minutes.

title: Veg Manchurian
blurb: Crisp vegetable balls in a tangy Indo-Chinese sauce.
steps: Grate the cabbage and carrot, mix with maida, corn flour and salt, and shape into balls.
Deep fry until golden.
Sauté garlic, onion and capsicum, add sauces and a little corn flour slurry.
Toss the balls in the sauce.

title: Veg Momos
blurb: Steamed dumplings with a cabbage and carrot filling.
steps: Knead maida into a firm dough and rest for 20 minutes.
Mix finely chopped vegetables with garlic and a little sauce for the filling.
Roll thin rounds, fill, pleat and steam for 10 minutes.
Serve with chilli sauce.

title: Margherita Pizza
blurb: Classic tomato, mozzarella and oregano pizza.
steps: Heat the oven to 220°C.
Spread sauce on the base, top with mozzarella and tomato slices.
Bake for 10 minutes and finish with oregano and chilli flakes.

title: Paneer Pizza
blurb: Pizza topped with paneer, capsicum and onion.
steps: Heat the oven to 220°C.
Spread sauce on the base and add paneer, capsicum and onion.
Cover with mozzarella and bake for 10–12 minutes.
Sprinkle with seasoning and chilli flakes.

title: Vegetable Soup
blurb: Light and warming mixed vegetable soup.
steps: Sauté onion in butter, add the chopped vegetables.
Add 4 cups of water and simmer for 15 minutes.
Season with pepper and salt.

title: Tomato Soup
blurb: Smooth, buttery tomato soup with a swirl of cream.
steps: Cook onion, garlic and chopped tomato in butter with the bay leaf until soft.
Add water, simmer for 10 minutes, then blend and strain.
Season with pepper and sugar and swirl in cream.

title: Sweet Corn Soup
blurb: Thick, mildly sweet corn soup with vegetables.
steps: Boil half the corn with water and blend coarsely.
Add the remaining corn and chopped vegetables and simmer for 8 minutes.
Stir in a corn flour slurry until thick, then add soy sauce, vinegar and pepper.

title: Hummus & Pita
blurb: Creamy chickpea dip with warm pita.
steps: Cook the chickpeas until very soft.
Blend with tahini, lemon juice, garlic, cumin and a little water until smooth.
Drizzle with olive oil and serve with warm pita.

title: Greek Salad
blurb: Fresh cucumber, tomato and olives with feta.
steps: Chop the cucumber, tomato and onion into chunks.
Toss with olives and crumbled feta.
Dress with olive oil, lemon juice and oregano.

title: Fruit Custard
blurb: Chilled vanilla custard with chopped seasonal fruit.
steps: Mix custard powder with a little cold milk.
Boil the rest of the milk with sugar, stir in the paste and cook until thick.
Cool, chill, then fold in the chopped fruit.
